content: Even though our model has proven its mettle, the effect of tag information seems relatively weak in the case of SNLI, which contains a large amount of data compared to the others. One possible explanation is that neural models may learn some syntactic rules from large amounts of text when the text size is large enough, reducing the necessity of external linguistic knowledge. We leave the exploration of the effectiveness of tags relative to data size for future work.
